body.html: Greenish Hotel (Greenish Ranong) is a small boutique hotel of around 15 rooms in the Khao Niwet area of central Ranong. What earns it good scores in reviews is that it's a brand-new hotel that still feels fresh and very clean — review after review says the rooms look new, everything is still neat, and the setting is quiet. It's a closely run place, a fit for travellers who want a clean, simple room in town rather than a big hotel with every facility. Most guests choose it to rest, to catch a boat to Koh Phayam, or to use Ranong as a stopover, while wanting a good night's sleep at a price that's still easy on the wallet.

The most consistently praised things in reviews are cleanliness, comfortable beds, and attentive staff. Many reviews describe very clean rooms, beds that are easy to sleep on, good showers and bathrooms, and rooms that feel fairly spacious for the price. Breakfast is another highlight — some reviews even call it better than expected. The front desk is friendly and helpful, and a few guests mention the hotel arranging drop-offs to nearby restaurants, a touch they appreciated. Rooms have air conditioning, TV, hot water and Wi-Fi, and some rooms have a balcony.
"Brand-new hotel, very clean and very quiet, spacious comfortable room, friendly and helpful staff, and a better-than-expected breakfast — great value."

The atmosphere leans into simplicity and quiet. There's a small garden, free private parking, and Wi-Fi in the common areas. Its small size and close management mean many guests feel the staff genuinely care, helping with recommendations for food and things to do in a warm, easy way. The location is in town, walkable to a 7-Eleven, an Amazon coffee shop and several good Thai restaurants nearby, which is handy for anyone who wants to stroll out for dinner without driving far.

There are a few things worth knowing before you book. First, it's a small hotel with no lift — an upper-floor room means stairs, so if you have a lot of luggage or find stairs hard, ask for a ground-floor room. Second, it's a brand-new property, and some reviews note a few small quirks still being sorted, though staff resolve them quickly. And because it's small, facilities are limited — there's no pool or gym. Review numbers are still modest because it only opened recently, so the score leans on its early guests.

The location is both a strength and a limit. It's in the Khao Niwet area of central Ranong, about 3 km from Ranong pier, handy for anyone catching a boat to Koh Phayam or Koh Chang. A convenience store, a coffee shop and restaurants are walkable nearby. But the hotel sits a fair way from the old town and some restaurants — a few reviews suggest a car if you want to roam further afield for food. Raksawarin Hot Spring is about 4 km away, a short drive or ride. Ranong is a rainy place, so pack an umbrella and a backup indoor plan.

The honest bottom line: Greenish Hotel suits travellers who want a brand-new, clean, quiet room with a comfortable bed, in town and walkable to food, at an affordable price. If you value cleanliness, newness and close, caring service, it's strong value at this price. But if you expect a big hotel with a lift, a pool and full facilities, or want to stay right by the old town or the hot spring, a small new place like this may not be what you're after — look at the higher-tier options or the hot-spring side in this series instead.

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — Greenish Hotel Ranong

faq.q: Where is Greenish Hotel in Ranong · what's nearby?
faq.a: It's at 98 Soi Ranong Pattana 1, Chaloem Phrakiat 6 Rop Rd., Khao Niwet, Mueang Ranong, in central Ranong. It's walkable to a 7-Eleven, a coffee shop and restaurants nearby. It's about 3 km from Ranong pier (for Koh Phayam) and about 4 km from Raksawarin Hot Spring, both a short drive or ride away.

faq.q: How much does Greenish Hotel cost · what room types are there?
faq.a: Prices start from approx. THB 800/night for a Standard Single. Options range from twin and double rooms up to a Deluxe Room at a higher rate. Rates vary by season and package, so compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Is Greenish Hotel a new hotel · what are the rooms like?
faq.a: It's a small, recently opened boutique hotel of around 15 rooms. Many reviews praise rooms that look new, are very clean, have comfortable beds and are quiet. Some rooms have a balcony. Because it's small, there's no lift — an upper-floor room means stairs.

faq.q: What is the breakfast like at Greenish Hotel?
faq.a: Breakfast is a highlight in many reviews, with some guests calling it better than expected for a small hotel. It's served at the hotel — ask about serving times at check-in and eat before you head out for a boat or sightseeing.

faq.q: Who is Greenish Hotel best for?
faq.a: It's a strong fit for travellers who want a brand-new, clean, quiet room in town, walkable to food, at an affordable price, and for anyone catching a boat to Koh Phayam. If you want a big hotel with a lift and a pool, or want to stay by the hot spring, other options in this series may suit you better.

faq.q: Does Greenish Hotel have parking · is there a lift?
faq.a: Yes, there's free private parking and a small garden. The thing to know is that it's a small hotel with no lift — upper-floor rooms mean stairs, so if you have a lot of luggage or find stairs hard, ask for a ground-floor room at booking.
